name: PSYCHO POKER
description: Psycho Poker is a poker variant in which players wager over which hand is best according to the game's rules, with psychological or unusual rule twists typical of home-game variants. Standard poker hand rankings apply.

content.text: Psycho Poker is a poker variant in which players wager over which hand is best according to the game's rules, with psychological or unusual rule twists typical of home-game variants. Standard poker hand rankings apply.

Poker was popularized in the American South in the early 19th century. Psycho Poker is a home-game or dealer's-choice style variant with psychological or unusual rules, documented in poker variant sources.
Standard 52-card deck and poker chips (or equivalent) for betting.
Dealer shuffles; player to dealer's right cuts. Dealer deals five cards to each player one at a time, face-down, beginning with the player to the left. Remaining deck forms the stock.
